info.name: Sigma-Aldrich Product Search Pricing and Availability Products API

params.name: q
params.description: Search query (product name, catalog number, CAS number, or formula)

params.name: brand
params.description: Filter by brand (e.g., Sigma, Aldrich, Fluka, Supelco)

items.docs: Search the Sigma-Aldrich product catalog by keyword, product name, catalog number, CAS number, or chemical formula. Returns paginated product results with basic metadata.

params.name: catalogNumber
params.description: Sigma-Aldrich catalog number (e.g., A1048, M8159, CAS1234-56-7)

items.docs: Returns detailed information for a specific product by its Sigma-Aldrich catalog number, including specifications, synonyms, physicochemical properties, safety data, and packaging options.

params.name: casNumber
params.description: CAS Registry Number in standard format (e.g., 7732-18-5 for water)

items.docs: Returns products matching a Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) Registry Number. Multiple products may match a CAS number when a substance is available in different grades or formulations.
